title: acer glabrum var. tripartitum
intro: Acer glabrum var. tripartitum, commonly known as Rocky Mountain Maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of western North America. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Rocky Mountain Maple include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
